1.explanation:
• MultiSelect/README.md and its tools folder contain the code examples and underlying logic for initial selected items and clearing selections, so they show how the ‘x’ button and tags are implemented.
• ListBox/README.md describes how listboxes and their child options should be structured, including accessible grouping, which is the root of the grouping-role violation for the checkboxes.
• Checkbox/ shows how checkboxes should be used and labelled, relevant because the MultiSelect menu uses Checkbox components for options.
• Button/migrate-to-7.x.md covers how to provide accessible names on button icons, directly applicable to labeling the clear-selection buttons.
• InlineCheckbox/migrate-to-7.x.md documents styling and accessibility concerns for inline checkboxes, helping to ensure each option’s checkboxes have the proper ARIA semantics and grouping.
1.bug_scenario: The issue occurs in the React MultiSelect component when it is rendered with initial selected items. The little “x” clear-selection icon on each selected tag (and the clear-all “x” in the input field) has no accessible label or title, triggering a DAP violation “An interactive element/widget must have an accessible name.” When you expand the menu, each option is rendered as a checkbox within the listbox, but the checkboxes are not wrapped in a grouping container (e.g. a fieldset or element with role="group"), leading to multiple “Use grouping roles or elements to identify related form controls” violations. Additionally, the clear-icon SVG in the tag is given role="img" but no title or aria-label, triggering a “WAI-ARIA widget with IMG role must have a nonempty alternate text or a label” violation.
